Wildfire v1.0.1, December 7, 2021

Wildfire is an infection themed-video game developed in 30 hours for Eric Weng's high-school senior project.
To download the latest releases, visit https://github.com/SlavSquatSuperstar/wildfire-game-java/releases

How to Run: Open "launch.sh" with your operating system's command line program (Terminal or Command Prompt) to start the game
System Requirements: Java JRE 11 (recommended) or 8
- Download JRE: https://adoptium.net/ (Select version and click "Latest Release")

Credits
This app was created with Java using the Greenfoot Platform and ported to Gradle. Exporting was made possible by Benoit Heinrich's Greenfoot Runner repository.
- Greenfoot: https://greenfoot.org/door
